source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "urban publicness" OR (publicness AND ("public space" OR "public spaces" OR urban OR city))
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"urban publicness" OR (publicness AND ("public space" OR "public spaces" OR urban OR city)),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("urban publicness" OR ("publicness" AND ("public space" OR "public spaces" OR "city" OR "urban")))
